episodes.title: The Reporting Map Is Not One Map
episodes.subtitle: How a global CFO files climate data when Washington proposes rescission, Sacramento still wants Scope 1 and 2 by 10 November, and ISSB keeps spreading
episodes.description: An HBS-style teaching case set on 2 September 2026. After the SEC proposed full rescission of its 2024 climate rules and CARB moved the first SB 253 Scope 1 and 2 filing to 10 November 2026, a composite mid-cap industrial CFO must choose a reporting architecture across California, ISSB markets, and a narrowed CSRD.

episodes.title: The Calendar Decision: Should a CFO Elect Semiannual Reporting?
episodes.subtitle: SEC File No. S7-2026-15 and the board posture that will not wait
episodes.description: After the SEC proposed letting U.S. public companies replace Form 10-Q with a semiannual Form 10-S, a mid-cap industrial CFO must recommend the board posture.
